record.facility_name: CHEROKEE NATION W W HASTINGS INDIAN HOSPITAL

cms_provider_record.interpretation: This exact-CCN CMS record corroborates the legacy 100 S Bliss identity. Its address is retained as the CMS-recorded value and is not silently updated to the replacement campus.

cms_tribal_hospital_crosswalk.observation: CMS's IHS-CMS All Tribal Facilities Listing identifies WW HASTINGS INDIAN HOSPITAL as a Hospital, CCN 370171, Tahlequah, Oklahoma. CMS says its listing cross-referenced an IHS facility list with QCOR; created 2020-01-26.

cherokee_nation_hospital_operator.observation: Cherokee Nation's official W.W. Hastings page says the Nation assumed hospital operations and management on 2008-10-01. The Nation's current Health Services page describes CNHS as a tribally operated health system including one tribal hospital.

replacement_campus_history.observation: A separate 2026-09-27 review retained Cherokee Nation's announcement that the replacement W.W. Hastings Hospital at 19780 E. Ross Street opened to patients on 2026-07-11. Preserve the prior 100 S Bliss address as historical and the replacement-campus address as current operator evidence; this scope review does not resolve CMS CCN continuity or price-file attribution.

indian_health_service_self_governance_ev.tribes_list_observation: IHS's Office of Tribal Self-Governance lists Cherokee Nation among tribes participating in its self-governance program and reports 120 compacts and 147 funding agreements as of 2025-07-01.
indian_health_service_self_governance_ev.current_funding_record_observation: HHS TAGGS identifies award 60G930002 as IHS Office of Tribal Self-Governance, activity type Health Services, with period ending 2026-09-30; FY2026 entries name CHEROKEE NATION under 'Tribal Self-Governance Program: IHS Compacts/Funding Agreements', including a 2026-09-04 continuation.
indian_health_service_self_governance_ev.scope_note: These sources document the operator Nation's self-governance compact/funding-agreement status at the health-system level; they do not purport to allocate a specific TAGGS award line to this hospital.

legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, as defined by section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: An Indian Health Program includes a tribal health program; a tribal health program includes an Indian tribe that operates a health facility funded in whole or part by IHS through an ISDEAA contract or compact.

interpretation: CMS's exact-CCN provider record and IHS-CMS tribal-hospital crosswalk identify CCN 370171 as W.W. Hastings Indian Hospital. Cherokee Nation's official page identifies the Nation as operator; IHS identifies Cherokee Nation as a self-governance tribe and HHS TAGGS records current IHS Tribal Self-Governance Program compact/funding-agreement awards to the Nation through FY2026. Read with 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) and 25 USC 1603(12),(25), this supports classifying the hospital as operated by an Indian Health Program. The CMS/legacy 100 S Bliss address and the 2026 replacement campus at 19780 E Ross remain distinct historical/current address observations. This is a scope classification only; it does not assert current CCN continuity, pointer linkage, current MRF availability, absence, or file quality.
disposition_change_reason: New current HHS/IHS self-governance funding evidence and the exact CMS tribal-hospital crosswalk strengthen the documented Cherokee Nation operator evidence enough to apply the specific 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) scope exception; this is not an inference from the word 'Indian' or from tribal ownership alone.
next_action: Retain the scope classification and the separate 100 S Bliss / 19780 E Ross campus-transition history. Revisit if operator, IHS self-governance compact/funding status, the exact CCN-to-hospital relationship, or program status changes. Do not infer MRF availability or assign an MRF from the scope classification.
